newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia May 1-25 palm oil exports 547,382t-SGS.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia May 1-25 palm oil exports 547,382t-SGS.

text.p: Cargo surveyor Societe Generale de Surveillance (SGS) Malaysia Sdn Bhd said on Monday it estimated Malaysia's palm oil exports for May 1-25 at 547,382 tonnes against 549,976 tonnes for April 1-25.
It said the exports comprised 164,821 tonnes of RBD palm oil, 232,869 tonnes of RBD palm olein and 48,689 tonnes of RBD palm stearin. The other products totalled 101,003 tonnes.
India was the top buyer during the period, taking 109,400 tonnes, followed by Pakistan which bought 94,900 tonnes, China (74,100 tonnes) and Japan (37,250 tonnes).
Countries in the European Union bought 44,750 tonnes. -- Tan Lee Lee - Kuala Lumpur newsroom (603-230-7510)
